project_scope.availability_rule: Use source observations with observation_date <= local cutoff_date; source date is an availability proxy because publication timestamps are absent.

cutoff_selection.validation_metric: macro-averaged MAE across validation crop seasons
cutoff_selection.method: Compare registered feature bundles at each cutoff with rolling-origin out-of-fold predictions.
cutoff_selection.tie_break: Apply one-standard-error rule; among eligible checkpoints choose the earliest cutoff and among eligible bundles choose the fewest features.
cutoff_selection.test_policy: 2019-2022 was previously inspected for an initial candidate and is exploratory, not a pristine final test.

features.name: season_duration_days
features.formula: season_end_date - season_start_date
features.hypothesis: Length of the local growing window contextualizes how much of the crop cycle has elapsed.
features.availability: known from static calendar before prediction

features.name: tavg_mean_to_cutoff
features.formula: mean(meteorology.tavg from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Season-to-date thermal conditions influence development and yield formation.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: tmax_max_to_cutoff
features.formula: max(meteorology.tmax from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Extreme heat exposure can stress maize during sensitive growth periods.
features.expected_relationship: negative when heat is excessive; nonlinear otherwise
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: diurnal_range_mean_to_cutoff
features.formula: mean(tmax - tmin from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Mean diurnal temperature range represents day/night thermal conditions not captured by tavg alone.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: cwb_sum_to_cutoff
features.formula: sum(meteorology.cwb from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Accumulated crop water balance represents season-to-date water surplus or deficit.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: et0_sum_to_cutoff
features.formula: sum(meteorology.et0 from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Accumulated atmospheric water demand can indicate increasing crop water stress when water supply is limited.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: rad_sum_to_cutoff
features.formula: sum(meteorology.rad from season_start_date through cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Accumulated radiation represents energy available for crop growth up to forecast time.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: tavg_mean_last_30d
features.formula: mean(meteorology.tavg over the 30 calendar days ending at cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Recent thermal conditions may influence current crop development and near-term stress.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: cwb_sum_last_30d
features.formula: sum(meteorology.cwb over the 30 calendar days ending at cutoff_date)
features.hypothesis: Recent water surplus/deficit can capture short-term water stress.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: latest_ssm
features.formula: latest soil_moisture.ssm with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
features.hypothesis: Surface soil moisture near forecast time represents immediate water availability.
features.availability: observation dated on or before cutoff

features.name: latest_rsm
features.formula: latest soil_moisture.rsm with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
features.hypothesis: Root-zone soil moisture near forecast time represents crop-accessible water reserves.
features.availability: observation dated on or before cutoff

features.name: rsm_mean_last_30d
features.formula: mean soil_moisture.rsm over the 30 calendar days ending at cutoff_date
features.hypothesis: Recent root-zone water reserves represent water accessible during ongoing crop development.
features.availability: observations dated on or before cutoff

features.name: latest_ndvi
features.formula: latest ndvi.ndvi with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
features.hypothesis: Vegetation greenness by forecast time is a proxy for crop canopy development.
features.availability: observation date <= cutoff; publication time unavailable

features.name: ndvi_change_since_first_observation
features.formula: latest in-season NDVI - first in-season NDVI, both dated <= cutoff_date
features.hypothesis: Change in canopy greenness captures crop development trajectory, not only current state.
features.expected_relationship: positive when it reflects healthy canopy development
features.availability: requires at least two in-season NDVI observations dated <= cutoff

features.name: latest_fpar
features.formula: latest fpar.fpar with date <= cutoff_date and within the season
features.hypothesis: Absorbed photosynthetically active radiation by forecast time is a canopy productivity proxy.
features.availability: observation date <= cutoff; publication time unavailable

features.name: fpar_mean_to_cutoff
features.formula: mean fpar.fpar from season_start_date through cutoff_date
features.hypothesis: Season-to-date mean absorbed radiation represents accumulated canopy development.
features.availability: dekadal observation date <= cutoff; publication time unavailable

features.name: crop_area_percentage
features.formula: static crop_mask.crop_area_percentage by administrative unit
features.hypothesis: The share of administrative area under maize may contextualize regional yield heterogeneity and representativeness.
features.availability: static source attribute
features.leakage_risk: low; static mask is not year-specific

features.name: bulk_density
features.formula: static soil.bulk_density by administrative unit
features.hypothesis: Soil bulk density can constrain root penetration and water movement, affecting crop performance.
features.expected_relationship: negative when high bulk density limits roots; context-dependent
features.availability: static source attribute

features.name: available_water_capacity_cm_m
features.formula: static soil.awc by administrative unit
features.hypothesis: Higher available water capacity can increase soil water storage accessible to the crop.
features.availability: static source attribute

features.name: latitude_deg
features.formula: static centroid latitude by administrative unit
features.hypothesis: Latitude can represent spatial gradients in climate and growing conditions across Argentina.
features.expected_relationship: spatially varying; no monotonic sign assumed
features.availability: static source attribute
features.leakage_risk: low; transfer to unseen regions requires spatial validation

features.name: longitude_deg
features.formula: static centroid longitude by administrative unit
features.hypothesis: Longitude can represent west-east environmental gradients across Argentina.
features.expected_relationship: spatially varying; no monotonic sign assumed
features.availability: static source attribute
features.leakage_risk: low; transfer to unseen regions requires spatial validation

features.name: drainage_class_code
features.formula: source categorical drainage class code; one-hot encode in a training pipeline
features.hypothesis: Drainage regime can affect waterlogging and root-zone water availability.
features.expected_relationship: class-specific; labels and ordering not assumed
features.availability: static source attribute
features.interpretability: low until code labels are obtained

excluded_pending_metadata.prec: Physical unit remains provisional despite documented CWB formula; do not use in the primary feature set until confirmed.
excluded_pending_metadata.vpd: Definition known but unit is unresolved.
excluded_pending_metadata.latitude_longitude: Raw degree coordinates are candidates; CRS is unresolved, so no projections or distances are derived.
excluded_pending_metadata.yield_derived_history: Not included to avoid target leakage and extra temporal-fold complexity.

evaluation_policy.baseline: DummyRegressor(global training median) and a fixed climate_core HistGradientBoostingRegressor baseline
evaluation_policy.feature_selection_metric: macro-average out-of-fold MAE over rolling-origin validation seasons; pooled MAE/RMSE reported as secondary metrics
evaluation_policy.feature_ablation_policy: On validation only, remove a candidate if leave-one-feature-out ablation lowers macro-season MAE; flag Pearson correlations >= 0.9 for review without automatic deletion.
evaluation_policy.test_seasons: 2019/20-2022/23; this holdout was previously inspected for an initial candidate and is exploratory, not a pristine final test
evaluation_policy.zero_yield_policy: Keep observed zero yields; do not drop or transform targets.
evaluation_policy.missing_feature_policy: Keep the common target cohort at every cutoff; HistGradientBoostingRegressor handles NaN features natively; report per-feature coverage.
evaluation_policy.cutoff_selection: Jointly compare the pre-registered feature bundles at 25%, 50%, and 75% using rolling-origin out-of-fold macro-MAE; choose the earliest cutoff within one standard error of the raw best.
evaluation_policy.feature_bundle_selection: At the selected cutoff choose the fewest-feature pre-registered bundle within one standard error of the raw best; then apply the validation-only feature ablation rule.
evaluation_policy.test_policy: Fit selected bundle/checkpoint on all development seasons and report 2019/20-2022/23 as an exploratory holdout; acquire future data for a pristine final test.
evaluation_policy.spatial_generalization: Report temporal performance by region; unseen-region performance is not claimed in this pass.
